text: The model flagged this applicant as high‑risk because of three recent credit‑behavior signals that each push the default probability upward. First, the borrower has been 60‑89 days past due on two accounts (value = 2), and this alone adds about +2.0 points to the risk score. Second, there are three instances of 30‑59‑day delinquencies (value = 3), contributing another +1.8 points. Finally, the revolving‑credit utilization is about 62 % of the available limit, which adds roughly +0.6 points. Together, these three factors raise the model’s estimate of default risk to 97.6 %, resulting in the “high risk” decision.
